task.title: Restore the merged Tasks queue in the desktop app
task.description:
Workbench had a merged Tasks table across every imported project, with filtering, status changes and opening a task's board route from a row. The move left it out so the shell could be exercised from this repository before more of it ships; this task brings it back.

The removal is a single commit on the move's branch, named in that pull request, so restoring is a revert of that commit plus whatever the shell changed since. It covered: the `view-queue` section and its filter groups, the status menu, the `queue:load`, `project:statuses` and `task:status` channels, the status cache in `main.js`, and `listTasks`, `listStatuses` and `setStatus` in `workbook.js`.

Depends on the move.
